verdict.rationale: Gitleaks supports a documented TOML-based configuration format for writing custom secret-detection rules, including composite rules combining primary/auxiliary conditions, and configs can be centralized/shared via a repo-root gitleaks.toml or the GITLEAKS_CONFIG env var so the same ruleset can be reused across repos. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of rule-authoring ease, no evidence of a rule-sharing marketplace or versioned rule-package mechanism beyond a single config file, and no discussion of syntax complexity for advanced composite rules.
